key.inventoryshift.shift: Shift Inventory Rows (hold Shift to reverse)
key.inventoryshift.shift_column: Shift Selected Column (hold Shift to reverse)
key.inventoryshift.toggle_lock: Lock or Unlock Selected Hotbar Slot
config.inventoryshift.title: Inventory Shift
config.inventoryshift.skip_empty.descrip: Jump past rows that are completely empty, so the hotbar never lands on nothing. If every other row is empty, shifting does nothing.
config.inventoryshift.column_modifier.de: Hold this while pressing the shift key to move only the column of the selected hotbar slot.
config.inventoryshift.scroll_enabled.des: Hold the scroll modifier and scroll to shift. Scrolling down moves the rows down, scrolling up moves them back.
config.inventoryshift.scroll_modifier.de: The key to hold while scrolling.
config.inventoryshift.scroll_target.desc: Whether scrolling moves every row or only the column of the selected hotbar slot.
config.inventoryshift.preview_mode.descr: Shows the row that the next shift brings into the hotbar. Hold Shift to see the row for the reverse direction.
config.inventoryshift.preview_offset.des: Raises the preview strip by this many pixels. Negative values lower it.
config.inventoryshift.sound.description: Play a soft pop when the inventory shifts.
config.inventoryshift.animation.descript: Make the items that arrive in the hotbar bounce, like items being picked up.
config.inventoryshift.group.locked.descr: The column of a locked slot never moves. Locked slots show a small gold line on the hotbar.
